tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List every Bannerify template in the workspace, with the layers you can override. Use this to find the template id before generating.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Read one template: its name and the layers you can override when generating an image or PDF.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read the Bannerify project linked to the connected account.

tools.name: create_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a Bannerify template and return it inline. Pass layer overrides in `modifications`.

tools.name: create_pdf
tools.description: Generate a PDF from a Bannerify template and return a link to the stored file. Pass layer overrides in `modifications`.

tools.name: create_image_from_shapes
tools.description: Create an image from shapes you compose yourself, without a template. Use this when no template fits, or the user wants a one-off design: a banner, a label, an invoice.
